EventChannel.off(string eventName,function fn)

Cancel listening for an event. If the second argument is provided, only the provided listening function is canceled. Otherwise, all listening functions are canceled.

Parameter

string eventName

Event name

function fn

Event listening function

Parameters

any args

Event triggering parameter

Sample Code

Page({
  onLoad() {
    const eventChannel = this.getOpenerEventChannel();
    const sampleEvent = (data) => {
      console.log(data);
    }
    eventChannel.on('MacleA', sampleEvent);
    eventChannel.off('MacleA', sampleEvent);
  }
});
